Hi Sofia — thanks, we can absolutely do that. Attaching a concise packet (PDF) that includes: network diagram, tenant isolation matrix, and a 2-page threat summary focused on KV cache and lateral movement scenarios.

Quick notes up front:
- Ingress: customer traffic terminates at per-region ingress load balancers and is routed to model-serving pools. We support private connectivity (VPC peering or PrivateLink) and public HTTPS with TLS 1.3.
- Sidecars: we run an optional sidecar that handles auth, TLS termination for private deployments, and egress filtering. For hosted deployments, sidecar functionality is provided by our tenant-proxy layer with strict namespace isolation.
- KV cache: per-request KV caches are scoped to runtime instances and are flushed on instance teardown; secrets/KV values are encrypted at rest and not written to shared volumes.

Attachments: emeraldcare-rfi-answers.pdf, redwood-inference-network-diagram.pdf, tenant-isolation-matrix.csv

If you want a walkthrough, I can set up a 45-minute call next week and loop in Irene (runtime security) and Vanessa (networking).
